content.title: FAG 6308 Deep Groove Ball Bearing - 40mm Bore x 90mm OD x 23mm Width, Chrome Steel
content.short_description: FAG 6308 deep groove ball bearing with 40mm bore, 90mm OD, and 23mm width. Chrome steel construction rated to 40.8 kN dynamic load and 8500 rpm limiting speed.
content.long_description:
The FAG 6308 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing constructed from chrome steel (GCr15/52100) rings and rolling elements. It is manufactured to ABEC-1 / P0 precision class, the standard tolerance grade for general industrial rotating equipment applications.

Dimensionally, the 6308 has a 40 mm bore diameter, 90 mm outer diameter, and 23 mm width, following standard metric deep groove ball bearing dimensions for the 63-series. The bearing carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 40.8 kN and a static load rating (C0) of 24 kN, indicating its capacity to handle combined radial and moderate axial loads under rotating and stationary conditions respectively.

The limiting speed for the FAG 6308 is rated at 8500 rpm. Deep groove ball bearings of this design are commonly specified in pumps, motors, gearboxes, and general mechanical power transmission systems where radial loads predominate with some axial load capability required.

Procurement and maintenance personnel should confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances against the ABEC-1 / P0 precision class before installation, and verify that operating speed and load conditions remain within the stated dynamic and static load ratings and limiting speed.
